recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-33012 unless a future work group decision changes extension SearchParameter base guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-33012 was a Published FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking the SearchParameters on Extensions guidance to replace the instruction that multi-resource extension contexts require SearchParameter.base = "DomainResource" with guidance to use multiple elements in the SearchParameter.base array.
initial_application: Commit 73c53b6ec72675612623085d966e510b7297949e, merged via HL7/fhir#1960, explicitly applied FHIR-33012 by changing source/searchparameter/searchparameter-notes.xml from the DomainResource requirement to the multiple SearchParameter.base array wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps SearchParameter active in the current build. The originating Zulip thread and FHIR-I minutes explain that the DomainResource wording was a DSTU2-era workaround from when SearchParameter.base was 1..1, while base has been 1..* since STU3. Later FHIR-27134 cleanup rewrote the same page for FHIRPath/search indexing guidance but preserved the FHIR-33012 multiple-base-array rule.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/searchparameter/searchparameter-notes.xml already says multi-resource extension contexts are represented with multiple SearchParameter.base array elements, and a stale-text search found no remaining active SearchParameter instruction requiring DomainResource.

related_jiras.note: Later Published SearchParameter extension-search cleanup touched the same source page and preserved the FHIR-33012 multiple-base-array wording while addressing separate FHIRPath/indexing guidance.
